name: Arch-Warlock
author: Hendrik Berends
description: An Arch-Warlock is what a Skryre engineer becomes if he survives long enough. The brass harness bolted to his skull shows him the winds of magic directly, and he draws on them the way his clan builds everything else – too fast, too much, and never once expecting it to go wrong.

abilities.name: Warp-Energy Harness
abilities.text: When this fighter makes the Channel action, if the 2D6 roll on the Magical Calamity table is a 2, treat it as a 3 instead.

abilities.name: Death Frenzy
abilities.text: Magical ability. Select a friendly `SKAVEN` fighter within (X)" of this fighter. Until the end of the battle round, increase its Attacks characteristic by 1 and it cannot make retreat actions. At the end of the battle round, allocate (X/2) damage points to that fighter.

abilities.name: Howling Warpgale
abilities.text: Magical ability. Until the end of the battle round, enemy fighters within (X)" of this fighter must reduce their Move characteristic by 2 and their Shoot characteristic by 1.
